description: Returns Brazilian company data from BrasilAPI (CNPJ lookup, MIT licence): legal name, trade name, status, opening date, legal nature, CNAE activities, address, share capital, and partners (QSA). CNPJ check digits are validated before any network call. Rate limit: BrasilAPI allows ~3 req/s. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

cnpj.description: CNPJ number — 14 digits, with or without formatting (e.g. 00.000.000/0001-91 or 00000000000191)
